title: Canonical evaluation comparison for the explicit cycle-pullback tower
statement: Let A be abelian, B a category, T : A ⥤ A, π : T ⟶ 𝟭 A, F : B ⥤ CochainComplex A ℤ and N ∈ ℤ. For b ∈ B and i ≤ N in the explicit tower [def-pc-cycle-pullback-tower-data-stage3], define P_i in B ⥤ A as the pullback of targetD F i (i+1) and kernel.ι(differential(i+1)) ≫ augmentation(i+1). The proved recursive-stage equality identifies term i with P_i ⋙ T. Define canonicalComparison as evaluation of this equality followed by T.mapIso of the composition of the canonical evaluation/pullback isomorphism and the pullback map induced by the canonical evaluation/kernel isomorphism. Its source is (term i).obj b and its target is T.obj of the pointwise pullback over ker((differential(i+1)).app b). All equality proofs and all isomorphism data are fully proved constructions.
